assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has recurrent episodes of supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are characterized by palpitations and lightheadedness
The procedure was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The procedure was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
The procedure was pending precertification under Reason Code CO-197
